midGrok:
Two Months Later – Ji-eun’s Quiet Blooming

Over the past two months, Ji-eun’s life at Bean & Veil had evolved into something deeper and more vibrant. Her 175cm statuesque figure had become even more radiant — long silky jet-black hair flowing like liquid night, golden-flecked doe eyes carrying a perpetual warm glow, and her perfect heroine-like proportions accentuated by subtle enhancements from her Eternal Warden class. She moved through the cafe with graceful confidence, creating small sanctuaries for customers while her rooftop garden flourished.
